item.title: Jon Pardi and Wife Summer Divorcing After 5 Years of Marriage
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to the latest entertainment update. We've got some news to share with you about country singer Jon Pardi and his wife Summer.
[Soft music transitions in]
Host: After five years of marriage, the couple has announced they're going their separate ways. In a joint statement on social media, they shared that they've made the difficult decision to end their marriage, but their daughters, Presley Fawn and Sienna Grace, will always be their top priority.
[Short music break]
Host: Jon and Summer got married in November 2020, and met back in 2017 on a blind date. They got engaged during one of Jon's concerts at the Ryman Auditorium in Nashville in 2019.
[Music transitions back in]
Host: Jon has also shared that he'll be taking some time away from social media to focus on himself and his family. His team will handle his social media accounts for now, and he's looking forward to seeing his fans at his upcoming shows.
[Outro music starts playing]
Host: Jon Pardi's Honkytonk Hollywood tour is still on, and it's scheduled to wrap up on December 11th in Las Vegas. We wish Jon and Summer all the best as they navigate this new chapter in their lives.
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
Host: That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in!
